job_spec.name: hgi_vm_bta2-74fdec20c-tc-cl
job_spec.purpose: el1011-hbm-hcvm/vm round 2 of the hard bank tile ot_hgi_vm_btile (fixes hgi_vm_bta/btb-a7bf28890 NEEDS_RTL TT -43.42/-134.39, FF -21.17/-42.85 by path class): bid strap pin-flopped (bid pin -> em -134); W2 queue holds the SECDED-encoded word, read = raw capture -> one-hot kept select -> m_wd (b2_g -> m_wd -92); decode register duplicated per destination + registered per-word correction flags (u_d -> pins -44, raw -> d_ce -25); hold-delay stage ot_hdly N2 on the W2 macro address inputs (rp/wp -> u_q addr FF -43/-22). Latency unchanged. Macro origins snapped onto the track grid (74fdec20c) after macro_grid_lint REFUSE of -58a5b03ec. Structural fix for hgi_vm_tb-ee633319d EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (CTS hold -228 ps on 51k endpoints = one clock tree over 1.4x1.08 mm + 64 macros, class 1): each bank = its own hardened tile with its own clock tree (2 VM macros + 3 W2 SRAM queues in one column, RP row queues, select/encode, decode), every input in a pin flop (= down-tree r2 / DMA line last stage), every output a flop. Parent = 32 tiles + hub (shadow lane state) + aperture block. Variant a: PD 0.45. Benches: full lockstep vs ot_hgi_vm_unit (Verilator) + 6 mutants FAIL.

rtl_boundary.waive: every input lands in a pin flop (gq/lq/wh_q/wr_q/we_q/wm_q/p0_*), every output is a flop (u_*, rr rv/rdat, crq, dnl, ev/em); 5 SRAM macros make the daemon probe slow.
